title: Institutional Engagement Award
eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full or Fellow member with 2+ years' membership at application; application must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; applicant's institution must have 3+ active Society members. Associate members ineligible. One award per institution per calendar year.

title: Education and Teaching Award
eligibility_summary: Members with at least 3 years of assured funding in a teaching-focused position from award date; based at a UK or Republic of Ireland institution; current Physiological Society member with 2+ years' consecutive membership. Preference to those in first 5 years of a HE teaching career. Associate members ineligible.
summary: Supports members to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiology education; up to £10,000, can part-fund larger projects; funds usable within 12 months.

title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
eligibility_summary: Full Members who are postdoctoral researchers (12+ months left on contract), or <3 years into a first permanent academic post, or returning from a career break; based at a UK or Republic of Ireland institution; Full member or Fellow with 2+ years' consecutive membership. PhD students and Associate members ineligible.
summary: Supports members to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique, finalise a project, or promote knowledge exchange/impact; up to £10,000, can part-fund larger projects; funds usable within 12 months.

title: The Paton Historical Studies Fund
eligibility_summary: Any Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of the Physiological Society. Associate members ineligible.
summary: Small grants to promote research or engagement activities in the history of modern physiology (archive visits, lectures, cataloguing collections, publication costs, oral histories); individual costed projects up to £1000, considered by the History & Archives Group. Applications by email (500-word summary, costings, CV) to history@physoc.org.

eligibility_summary: Applicants currently in a postdoctoral (fixed-term) role, based at a UK or Republic of Ireland institution, conducting research advancing physiology, on an academic research career track, with one or more years of paid Society membership. Associate members ineligible.
summary: Supports postdoctoral researchers to overcome barriers holding them back (research consumables, professional-body registration, sundries); up to £2,500; normally awarded once per membership; funds usable within 12 months. Cannot fund salaries or conference travel.
